title: Hybrid and Component-wise Leggett-Williams type Fixed Point Theorems in Product Spaces with Applications
summary: In this paper, we present new multiplicity fixed point theorems for operators acting on Cartesian products of two normed linear spaces. We show that Leggett-Williams type conditions in each component of the system guarantee the existence of nine distinct fixed points, of which four of them are coexistence fixed points, i.e., points with all components nontrivial. In addition, a hybrid approach combining Leggett-Williams conditions in one component with Krasnosel'skii compression-expansion conditions in the other allows us to obtain three fixed points.
